description:
前新加坡世界小姐张思丽曾为国际赛把鱼尾狮“穿”在身上，展示国家特色。她在1986至1989年间横扫多项选美冠军，又因具大学学历而备受瞩目。她忆述比赛前为打造层次感的大卷发，需整夜以发夹固定头发、难以入眠。7, 80年代盛行喇叭裤、迷你裙、多色线条与几何图案，纱笼卡峇雅是街头常见的时尚，更是新航空姐制服的灵感来源。潮流虽会消逝，却也会循环再度成为新风尚。 

Former Miss Singapore Teo Ser Lee once “wore” the Merlion in an international pageant to showcase Singapore’s identity. Winning multiple titles between 1986 and 1989, she stood out for her university education. She recalls spending sleepless nights before competitions, setting her hair in clips to achieve voluminous waves. Fashion in the 1970s and 1980s featured boots, bell-bottoms, miniskirts, bold geometric prints, and florals, while the Sarong Kebaya—now iconic as the SIA uniform—was a popular street style. Trends fade but often return, and today’s fashion may simply be the revival of the old times.

#SG60 #新加坡60
